hub.headline: Cosmo3D was an SGI scene graph library that was cut short in favour of OpenGL++ and Fahrenheit.
hub.maker: SGI (Silicon Graphics); Fahrenheit was a joint SGI and Microsoft program
hub.next: Look for primary SGI documents on Cosmo3D and OpenGL Optimizer.
hub.what_it_was: Cosmo3D was an SGI scene graph library that reached beta before SGI halted it to pursue OpenGL++. It shipped only as the layer underneath OpenGL Optimizer. Its line then fed the Fahrenheit program, announced by SGI and Microsoft in December 1997 and ended by 2000; only Fahrenheit's XSG scene graph ever shipped, briefly.
hub.what_survives: No standalone Cosmo3D source release is known, and rights are unresolved. Only historical write-ups survive publicly.

name: SGI Cosmo3D / OpenGL++
summary: Lost SGI scene-graph lineage behind OpenGL++ and the Fahrenheit program; lead status, primary source availability unverified.
